from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the provided collection, identified by title and its outgoing citations to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (from the collection) that this paper explicitly cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
